<P STYLE="margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: right; margin: 0"><B><I>Exhibit 3.1</I></B></P>

<P STYLE="margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: center">CERTIFICATE OF TRUST<BR>
OF<BR>
GOLUB CAPITAL PRIVATE INCOME FUND S</P>

<P STYLE="font: bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: center">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in">THIS CERTIFICATE OF TRUST of
Golub Capital Private Income Fund S (the &ldquo;Trust&rdquo;) is being duly executed and filed on behalf of the Trust by the undersigned,
as trustees, to form a statutory trust under the Delaware Statutory Trust Act (12 <U>Del. C.</U> Section 3801 <U>et seq</U>.) (the &ldquo;Act&rdquo;).</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in">1.&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&nbsp;<U>Name</U>.
The name of the statutory trust formed by this Certificate of Trust is Golub Capital Private Income Fund S.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in">2. &#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&nbsp;<U>Registered
Office; Registered Agent</U>. The business address of the Trust&rsquo;s registered office in the State of Delaware is Corporation Trust
Center, 1209 Orange Street, Wilmington, Delaware 19801. The name of the Trust&rsquo;s registered agent at such address is the Corporation
Trust Company.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in">3. &#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&nbsp;<U>Investment
Company</U>. The Trust will be regulated as a business development company under the Investment Company Act of 1940, as amended.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in">4.&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&nbsp;<U>Effective
Date</U>. This Certificate of Trust shall be effective upon filing.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in">IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the undersigned
have duly executed this Certificate of Trust in accordance with Section 3811(a)(1) of the Act.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0; width: 100%"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
<TD STYLE="width: 50%; text-align: left">&nbsp;</TD><TD STYLE="border-bottom: Black 1pt solid; text-align: justify; width: 50%">/s/ Thomas J. Shinnick</TD>
